name: Adversarial Attack on ACID Framework
aliases: Adversarial Attack on Neural Network Reconstruction
Adversarial attacks to ACID as whole
definition: An iterative process to find optimized solutions in the intersection of data-driven priors, sparse images, and measurement solutions, attacked by computing tiny perturbations via gradient ascent.
summary: This method computes a tiny input perturbation to maximize reconstruction differences in the ACID framework, distinguishing itself by addressing the entire iterative workflow rather than isolated neural networks.
